content: There has been a flurry of work in constructing datasets with an adversarial component, such as Swag BIBREF48 and HellaSwag BIBREF49, CODAH BIBREF50, Adversarial SQuAD BIBREF51, Lambada BIBREF52 and others. Our dataset is not to be confused with abductive NLI BIBREF53, which calls itself $\alpha $NLI, or ART.
